paragraphs: R' Chanina of Caesarea. See the entry R' Chanina, son of R' Abbahu.[^1]

notes.text: The heading supplies Chanina for ר״ח in the target. בריה דר׳ explicitly gives “son of R'”; it does not supply a full personal title. All three abbreviated title components remain R'. The locality is Caesarea.
